goodToKnow: Anbetracht only appears in the fixed phrase in Anbetracht (in view of, considering), followed by the genitive: in Anbetracht der Umstände, in Anbetracht der späten Stunde. In Anbetracht dessen, dass... means given that... It's formal; in speech, Germans say wegen or weil. A close synonym is angesichts: angesichts der Krise. From betrachten (to look at, consider).
